name: Story: 05:29:47, the end of Reyes' night (SC13)
notes: STORY steg 6, the morning act. Started by morning_road, or by morning_telex when the visit took the player. The old SC13's last minute and its fixed ending (S47Chapter6, THE EVENT: the CB opening by itself, the engine on the channel, the far voices, 05:29:47, then the old Story's end cards) as text, the night's own silence and the gear's flicker (FS47Omen), then the end beat: black, the title, the credits, the 1947 photograph, the Story marked completed, and back to the title (US47Flow::StoryNightEnd). Story is Reyes' night: Freeform takes place after it, with Reyes gone. Taken by the visit, the lines carry no hour (the time is gone). Left out: the truck stalling at C, the 47 seconds' flash and the camera pulling out over the empty bench (the old chapter's own road, truck and camera).

beats.text: The light let me go. The sheets are still with me. The time between is not.
The CB opens by itself. Nobody calls.
The walkie opens by itself. Nobody calls.
On the channel, small and a long way off, an engine idling. It sounds like yours.
05:29. On the radio, a man's voice, far away: Reference west. No. East.
On the radio, a man's voice, far away: Reference west. No. East.
A woman's voice: Don't stop at C.
